commitResults.messageTitle: Correct final guide limitations and UML
commitResults.messageBody:
Qualify startup validation and case-insensitive assignment filtering to match the current implementation and reported edge cases.

Split the oversized startup sequence into focused load and UI-outcome diagrams, and remove the duplicate directory screenshot from the find section.

commitResults.messageTitle: Clarify assignment whitespace and startup flow
commitResults.messageBody:
Document the non-breaking-space assignment limitation and the recovery commands so filtering and unassigned queries are not overstated.

Separate successful JSON parsing from load failure in the startup sequence, then regenerate its image to match the source.
Finalize v1.6 candidate screenshot and downloads

The manual-testing appendix still described the User Guide as an unpublished universal candidate after the v1.6 release. Label the packaging steps as pre-release validation and make the copy-and-launch test apply to the JAR under test, so maintainers can use the published guide without confusing candidate and release instructions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Build one JAR with universal Mac natives
commitResults.messageBody:
Merge matching JavaFX Mac libraries with Apple lipo in CI and verify both upstream slices. Preserve Windows and Linux payload checks and share the candidate across the platform matrix.

Keep published release instructions distinct from the unverified candidate. Native GUI smoke tests remain required before release.

Use the available checksum utility on Windows
Merge current release documentation into packaging
commitResults.messageBody: Resolve the packaging guide conflict while preserving the published v1.5 download instructions. Keep the universal build documented as an unreleased candidate.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep native checks out of default builds
commitResults.messageBody:
Skip packaged-native verification in ordinary Windows and Linux
check runs unless the prepared universal bundle is supplied.
Keep packaging CI's explicit verification and bundle-backed
platform checks intact, and document the task conditions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Prepare v1.6 version and candidate guides
commitResults.messageBody:
Set the application version to V1.6 and document the single universal
JAR for candidate testing. Preserve published v1.5 guidance and label
historical screenshots accurately while release verification is pending.

Specify public and Canvas filenames without changing artifact bytes.
No architecture or UML changes are required.

commitResults.messageTitle: Finalize v1.6 candidate screenshot and downloads
commitResults.messageBody: Verify the homepage scene against the preserved v1.6 JAR and label its provenance accurately. Separate current v1.5 downloads from draft candidate access while publication awaits final verification and approval.

Replace candidate-only notices with the published v1.6 release link and checksum instructions. Keep v1.5 and v1.4.1 guidance available for existing installations, and identify the homepage image as a v1.6 release capture.

Normalize pasted tab characters to ASCII spaces at the command
text-field boundary before JavaFX can discard them.

Add JavaFX regression coverage for one or multiple tabs, invalid
input, ordinary spaces, and persisted address/tag separation.
Document the paste behavior.

Delegate normalized tab paste to the inherited JavaFX operation so the
paste remains a separate undoable edit.

Add regression coverage that verifies Undo restores the exact
pre-paste text and Redo restores normalized content. Document the
override contract.

Normalize pasted tabs through a paste-scoped TextFormatter instead of
rewriting the system clipboard. This preserves inherited undo records
without relying on platform clipboard propagation.
estores normalized content. Document the
